name: mirage
text: Read it. Verdict: small gains, nothing that changes profit much. The app already uses ESPN's scoreboard for scores/grading and live clock. What the README adds: (1) CDN scoreboard (cdn.espn.com ?xhr=1), meant for real-time; could cut live-score lag a little for the live lane, worth a trial (it is free, unofficial, no SLA). (2) ESPN odds endpoint (DraftKings/FanDuel/Caesars/BetMGM/ESPN BET): game lines only, one provider's snapshot per call, not sharp, and those books are already in our feeds, so it would double-count (same-company rule) with no new information. (3) Win probabilities + play-by-play: useful as a cross-check for the live model, not as a price. (4) Power Index/QBR/recruiting/bracketology: not betting inputs we use. Plan unless you object: try the CDN scoreboard as a faster live-score source behind the existing ESPN call, measured against it, and keep it only if it's measurably fresher. Logged as CH46.
